name: Certified AI Insurance Professional
description: AI in claims, underwriting and fraud across US property and casualty insurance, under state insurance law.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Certified AI Insurance Professional

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must hold a current course certificate for each of these courses: AI for Property and Casualty Claims Adjusters (FIN-135); AI for Insurance Professionals (FIN-130); Building AI for Insurance Underwriting and Rating under State Insurance Law (FIN-235); Building AI for Insurance Fraud Detection and SIU Investigations (FIN-245). Every course certificate must be current (not revoked or expired) when the program certificate is issued; the program certificate is renewed when every course certificate is current again.

Each course exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a program certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
